question: What definition of 1C is used, and what share of theoretical capacity is reached on the first discharge at 0.1C?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%theoretical%' OR text ILIKE '%0.1C%' OR text ILIKE '%C-rate%' OR text ILIKE '%C rate%' ORDER BY page, id

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (3,5) AND (text ILIKE '%1675%' OR text ILIKE '%C = %' OR text ILIKE '%first discharge%' OR text ILIKE '%1C%' OR text ILIKE '%0.1C%' OR text ILIKE '%91%') ORDER BY page, line_no; SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p5.L60','p5.L61','p5.L62','p5.L63','p5.L64','p5.L65')
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE id IN ('p5.L58','p5.L59','p5.L60','p5.L61','p5.L62','p5.L63','p5.L64','p5.L65','p3.L6','p3.L7','p3.L8','p1.L10','p1.L11','p1.L12') ORDER BY id
SELECT id, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%1675%' OR text ILIKE '%C = %' OR text ILIKE '%C=%' ORDER BY page, id
